name: Machine row
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are level with your lower chest.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows past your sides.
Let your arms reach forward again with control.
cue: Chest on the pad, elbows back
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad to lean back.
Shrugging instead of squeezing the shoulder blades.
